# TracePII Shield MCP

Paid remote MCP for LLM trace PII scanning, payload redaction, sensitive field classification, privacy receipts, and trace audit exports.

Website: https://tracepiishield.clauxel.com/
MCP endpoint: https://tracepiishield.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://tracepiishield.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Docs: https://github.com/clauxel/tracepii-shield-mcp

Use case: Redact PII from LLM traces and tool payloads before they leave review.
Authentication: Bearer token required for production use.
Tools: scan_trace_pii, redact_tool_payload, classify_sensitive_field, issue_pii_receipt, export_trace_audit
